description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git commands related to diff-tree, max-depth, and pathspecs. It sets up test cases to verify Git's behavior with --max-depth options, directory structures, and specific file path patterns.

methods.name: make_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory and writes a specified content to a 'file' within it.

methods.name: make_files
methods.description: Creates a file and nested directories with the same base name.

methods.name: check_one
methods.description: Performs a test comparing the output of 'git diff-tree' with expected results, based on diff type, arguments, path, and max depth.

methods.name: check_trees
methods.description: Runs multiple 'check_one' tests for different max-depth scenarios on tree comparisons.

methods.name: check_index
methods.description: Runs tests for index comparisons with different max-depth settings.
